objective: Test form completion: after gate-progress reward reaches 0.4, prioritize untried forms for the same ordered column pair. Compare with hybrid random, form-blind enumeration and canonical-form enumeration using paired random numbers.
query: On a synthetic research panel, find cross-family factor hypotheses with genuine incremental predictive value for next-period returns.

dgp.seed_policy: Fresh development-evaluation seeds selected before execution. Seeds 2120-2124 are labelled development only. Sealed seeds 3000+ remain untouched.

oracle.truth_definition: Absolute overall Spearman correlation between candidate values and the per-month-standardized injected mechanism signal std(F_ep * sign(F_illiq)).

glm.note: F4b is fully local and contains no LLM/API arm.

interpretation.prefix_policy: Run one ordered B36 stream per arm and seed. B12 and B24 are immutable prefixes of the same stream; never rerun them as separate random paths.
interpretation.primary_comparison: hybrid_form_aware_b36 minus hybrid_random_b36 at B36 on alternative seeds.
interpretation.primary_continuous_test: One-sided exact paired sign-flip permutation test on seed-level max truth loading, statistic = mean paired difference, alpha = 0.05. Report mean and median paired effects.
interpretation.primary_binary_readout: One-sided exact paired McNemar/binomial test on discovery discordances; corroborative, not a second co-primary endpoint.
interpretation.secondary_comparison: hybrid_form_aware_b36 minus form_blind_b36 at B36, with the same continuous and binary paired tests.
interpretation.budget_trend: Within each arm, test B36 minus B12 using the same paired exact procedures. B24 is reported as a descriptive intermediate checkpoint.
interpretation.multiplicity: The primary continuous test alone controls the main alpha at 0.05. Secondary continuous tests are Holm-adjusted as one family; binary tests are labelled corroborative.
interpretation.success_rule: F4b supports the intervention only if the primary continuous one-sided exact p <= 0.05 and the mean paired effect is positive, while every safety constraint passes.

safety_constraints.valid_candidate_rate_margin: At B36, mean paired valid-candidate-rate difference F4b minus hybrid_random must be >= -0.05.
safety_constraints.relative_null_accept_margin: Mean paired null accept-rate difference F4b minus hybrid_random must be <= 0.02.
safety_constraints.absolute_null_target: The one-sided 95% Wilson upper bound for pooled F4b null accepts per trial must be <= 0.10.
safety_constraints.interpretation: These are predeclared fail-fast engineering constraints, not claims of equivalence.

interpretation.canonical_reference_label: The canonical-form enumerator has no truth-pair knowledge but is privileged with the injected truth's level-gate form; it is a reference line, not an upper bound.
interpretation.seed_independence: Seeds 2120-2124 are development-contaminated and excluded from inferential evaluation.

recipe_conformance_policy: Every declared recipe is checked by AST. hybrid_form_aware chooses the recipe implied by its selected gate form.
leakage_policy: Scheduling and form priority see only sanitized gate outcomes and failed-gate progress. Truth loading is computed only in the evaluation harness and never passed to a generator.
execution_note: Fully local, no API credentials. Protocol and all source-fingerprint files must match a committed HEAD before the harness creates output.
